planets.name: TOI-2406 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2406 with a 3.08-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-2406 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2406. Its orbit and size follow Hori et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
